rows.message: OrdersApiService.list (GET /orders) sends credentials to orders-api, whose CORS answers any origin with *: the browser blocks the answer
rows.evidence: the service enables CORS at src/main.ts:9, for a browser on another origin, and the setting was read
rows.fix: allow the front end's origin by name (origin: [...], or true to echo it) with credentials: true

config-not-set.why: the configuration module in src/app.module.ts validates the settings with a schema, which may give it a default

status-never-answered.why: POST /orders/:param/refund throws HttpException, whose status is not read
